Sandbox_AegisSiegeWaves_tooltip: How many horde waves the siege sends out.
Sandbox_AegisSiegeDistance_tooltip: Distance of the first wave in tiles. Very high values are outside the loaded area, nothing spawns there.
Sandbox_AegisSiegeGap_tooltip: Additional tiles of distance per further wave.
Sandbox_AegisSiegeRadius_tooltip: Spread of the zombies around the wave start point.
Sandbox_AegisSiegeLureMinutes_tooltip: Minutes the noise lure keeps pulsing at the activation spot. The horde walks there, not after the admin.
Sandbox_AegisSiegeCrawlers_tooltip: Waves consist of crawlers (sprinters take precedence).
Sandbox_AegisSiegeGunshot_tooltip: An audible gunshot marks the start.
Sandbox_AegisStormHours_tooltip: Duration of the triggered storm in hours.
Sandbox_AegisStormThunder_tooltip: Number of thunder strikes in the volley, 0 disables it.
Sandbox_AegisHeliCount_tooltip: Size of the approaching horde, 0 keeps it helicopter only.
Sandbox_AegisHeliDistance_tooltip: Distance of the approaching horde in tiles.
Sandbox_AegisHeliRadius_tooltip: Spread of the zombies around the start point.
Sandbox_AegisAirdropCount_tooltip: Number of zombies dropping from the sky.
Sandbox_AegisAirdropRadius_tooltip: Spread of the zombies around your position.
Sandbox_AegisAirdropHeight_tooltip: Height in levels the zombies fall from.
Sandbox_AegisFirestormHours_tooltip: Duration of the triggered storm in hours.
Sandbox_AegisFirestormThunder_tooltip: Number of thunder strikes in the volley, 0 disables it.
Sandbox_AegisFirestormWaves_tooltip: Number of burning groups, each from its own direction.
Sandbox_AegisFirestormDistance_tooltip: Distance of the burning groups in tiles.
Sandbox_AegisAmbushRain_tooltip: Rain starts when the ambush triggers.
Sandbox_AegisAmbushCount_tooltip: Number of crawlers appearing around you.
Sandbox_AegisAmbushRadius_tooltip: Spread of the crawlers around your position.
Sandbox_AegisPlayerPanel_tooltip: Off: nobody gets the blue player panel, admins included. The golden admin panel is untouched.
Sandbox_AegisPlayerClaims_tooltip: Lets players claim a zone at their own safehouse within their role budget. Off blocks every claim regardless of roles.
Sandbox_AegisPlayerKits_tooltip: The kits page in the player area, booster redeeming included. Off hides it for everyone; the kit editor for admins keeps working.
Sandbox_AegisPlayerVehicles_tooltip: How many vehicles a player may keep on the vehicles page of the player area. 0 turns remembering off. Ignored where Knox Claim runs, that mod brings its own limit. Vehicles already remembered are never dropped when you lower this.
Sandbox_AegisPlayerHealthInfection_toolt: Whether the player area's health page tells a player outright if they carry the real zombie infection. Vanilla keeps that uncertain on purpose, turn this off to keep the suspense. Wound infection and other injuries still show either way.
Sandbox_AegisPlayerStatsForAdmins_toolti: Whether kills, deaths, distance and best life get recorded for characters currently on an admin access level. On by default, turn off so admin testing does not skew the numbers.
Sandbox_AegisPlayerAutoAdminPowers_toolt: Whether godmode, invisibility and noclip switch on by themselves the moment a character gains an admin access level (vanilla behaviour). Turn off to keep them off until you enable them yourself. The full heal and hunger/thirst reset that comes with the same promotion cannot be prevented, that part is engine internal.
